mapper.sql: id, company_id, period, level, rule_code, description, create_by, status, llm_confidence, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO opc_insight_anomaly ( company_id, period, level, rule_code, description, create_by, status, llm_confidence, create_time, update_by, update_time ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{period}, #{level}, #{ruleCode}, #{description}, #{createBy}, #{status}, #{llmConfidence}, COALESCE(#{createTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{updateBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE opc_insight_anomaly SET status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
